picks.reasoning: Stats don't win series, stars do, and BLG's lineup has the best lane-winners in the field. One loss to MKOI doesn't change that. Fade the GEN hype.
KC own the best early game on the board, +1.2k gold at 15 over 34 games, and the team that snowballs the first drake and jungle tempo wins the map before the mid-game even starts.
Fearless rewards the team that still has answers on game five, and DK's flexible picks across every role have already dismantled G2 and T1 in draft this week.
GEN tops the board on game win rate (92-33, about 74%) and is 7-1 against other regions, and they've already beaten IG and HLE here, so the numbers point to them.
DK took down G2 and T1 on back-to-back days without blinking. That's a calm, connected room, and I'll back that over raw talent when the pressure hits.
